name: Adbear Image Cleaner
author: Secil Kars

sections.description:
Over time, WordPress websites collect many unnecessary image files from old posts, deleted pages, temporary uploads and unused media attachments. These files can make the Media Library harder to manage and increase storage usage.

Adbear Image Cleaner provides a simple and clean interface to scan your Media Library, review scan results and safely manage unused images directly from the WordPress admin panel.

Technically, the plugin runs a batched AJAX scan (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF), checks usage in post content, featured images, WooCommerce product images and ACF-like image meta values, lists unused or broken items in the admin screen, supports CSV export and moves items to Trash instead of deleting them permanently.

Scan Your Media Library

Run a scan to analyze images stored in the WordPress Media Library and detect potentially unused files.

Safe Cleanup Workflow

Instead of permanently deleting files immediately, images can be safely moved to trash for safer media management.

CSV Export Support

Export scan results as CSV files for review, reporting or manual cleanup workflows.

Lightweight Admin Interface

Simple and clean dashboard designed for fast and easy media management.

Results & Selection Tracking

Track scan results and selected images directly from the plugin dashboard.

Local Processing

All scanning and cleanup operations run locally on your WordPress website without external services.

Why Use Adbear Image Cleaner?

Many WordPress websites contain media files that are no longer needed. Managing large Media Libraries manually can become difficult over time.

Adbear Image Cleaner helps simplify this process by providing:

  • Media scanning
  • Organized scan results
  • Safer cleanup actions
  • Exportable reports
  • Lightweight management tools

Easy to Use

The plugin interface is designed to be simple and beginner-friendly:

  • Start a scan
  • Review detected images
  • Select unwanted files
  • Move selected items to trash
  • Export reports if needed

Built for WordPress

Adbear Image Cleaner is built specifically for WordPress websites and follows standard WordPress admin workflows.

The plugin focuses on simplicity, performance and safe media management without unnecessary complexity.

Privacy

Adbear Image Cleaner does not send or share your media data with third-party services.

All processing happens locally on your own server.

This plugin is published under the Adbear name and is not affiliated with any other product or brand that may use similar wording.
sections.installation:
1. Upload plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/Adbear-image-cleaner.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Open Image Cleaner from the admin menu.
  4. Start a scan and review results before trashing images.
sections.faq:
Will this plugin permanently delete my media files?

No. The plugin uses a safe delete flow and moves selected attachments to WordPress Trash first.

Does this support large media libraries?

Yes. The scanner runs in batched AJAX requests to reduce timeout risk on large sites.

What should I do before cleanup?

Always take a full backup before moving or deleting media files.
